newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee untraded on lack of dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee untraded on lack of dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee was untraded on Monday against the dollar due to a lack of commercial demand for the greenback, dealers said.
At 0430 GMT the rupee was quoted at 58.57 to the dollar, after opening at 58.52, they said.
"The rupee has eased mainly on the Central Bank's action and not due to any demand for dollars," said an American Express Bank dealer.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by four local cents, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.5263 and 59.7087.
Dealers say the dollar-rupee exchange rate should remain ranged in the absence of import bills.
Overnight call money was at 9.125 percent after opening at nine percent, they said.
The Central Bank's repo rate remained at 8.75 percent.
